topic.symptom: The PC shows a CPU fan error message when it starts.
topic.title: "CPU Fan Error" at Startup? Check the CPU_FAN Header

script: "CPU Fan Error" at startup? Shut down and unplug it first. Find the CPU_FAN header in your manual. If the cooler's fan is on CHA_FAN, move it to CPU_FAN. Plug it back in. Then start the PC and check again.

storyboard.title: "CPU Fan Error" at Startup? Check the CPU_FAN Header
storyboard.narrationStyle: Calm, conversational, one check. The captions are burned into the cut; no voice generated.

beats.visualDirection: The stylized PC lit; the monitor shows a stylized message, CPU Fan Error!

beats.narration: Shut down and unplug it first.
beats.visualDirection: At the back of the power supply, the power cord comes out of the inlet.

beats.narration: Find the CPU_FAN header in your manual.
beats.visualDirection: The side panel slides off; the camera closes on the CPU_FAN header near the top of the board, in an example layout, glowing amber; EXAMPLE LAYOUT.

beats.narration: If the cooler's fan is on CHA_FAN,
beats.visualDirection: The camera moves down to CHA_FAN: the cooler's fan plug sits there, a red cross beside it; AIO? CHECK ITS MANUAL.
beats.onScreenText: WRONG HEADER → AIO? CHECK ITS MANUAL

beats.visualDirection: The camera follows the plug from CHA_FAN up to CPU_FAN, where it lands, outlined green.
At the back, the power cord goes back into the power supply.

beats.narration: Then start the PC and check again.
beats.visualDirection: The unlit PC beside the dark monitor, its button pulsing amber. No start or message is shown.

storyboard.finalCta: Then start the PC and check again.
factualGuardrails: Never say: guaranteed cure for boot failures (It may not work; one check, never a guaranteed fix.)
Never say: disable the warning in BIOS settings instead (The cut does not advise switching the warning off.)
Never say: message disappears on the next start (The cut ends before anyone starts the PC; no result is shown.)
persistentDisclosures: Stylized example · not a fix for every PC

claims.proposition: unplug the power cable before working inside the PC
claims.basis: Crucial, "How to Install Memory in Your Desktop" (https://www.crucial.com/support/install-memory-desktop): "Shut down your system. Once your system has been powered off, unplug the power cable." Checked 2026-10-12 via search excerpts; the factual-takeaway gate re-reads it.

claims.proposition: the cooler's fan belongs on the CPU_FAN header, not CHA_FAN; the message means the fan is not detected
claims.basis: ASUS, "[Motherboard] Why I see the error message CPU FAN Error in POST? (FAQ 1006064)" (https://www.asus.com/support/faq/1006064/): "Search-excerpt wording: "CPU FAN Error" in POST means the system doesn't detect the FAN; make sure the CPU FAN cable is securely installed to the CPU_FAN connector instead of the CHA_FAN." Checked 2026-10-12 via search excerpts; the factual-takeaway gate re-reads it.

claims.proposition: check the CPU_FAN connection when the fan is not detected
claims.basis: ASUS, "[Motherboard] Troubleshooting - An error "CPU Over Temperature Error" occurs after bootup (FAQ 1043819)" (https://www.asus.com/us/support/faq/1043819/): "Search-excerpt summary: if the cooler fan is not running or cannot be detected (speed N/A), confirm it is properly connected to the CPU_FAN header on the motherboard." Checked 2026-10-12 via search excerpts; the factual-takeaway gate re-reads it.

claims.proposition: liquid coolers can be wired to other headers; their manual decides
claims.basis: ASUS ROG forum, "Asus Strix Z790-H Gaming WiFi: CPU FAN ERROR when AIO pump… (forum thread 937761)" (https://rog-forum.asus.com/t5/intel-700-600-series/asus-strix-z790-h-gaming-wifi-cpu-fan-error-when-aio-pump/td-p/937761): "Search-excerpt summary: for AIO liquid coolers, replies suggest the pump on AIO_PUMP and fans on CPU_FAN, and to follow the cooler's own manual." Checked 2026-10-12 via search excerpts; the factual-takeaway gate re-reads it.
